hints.title: Traverse Bits from Right to Left
hints.text: Simulate addition and division starting from the least significant bit, maintaining a carry bit.

hints.title: Step Cost per Bit
hints.text: If current bit plus carry is odd, we must add 1 then divide by 2, taking 2 steps and producing carry 1. If even, just divide by 2 taking 1 step.

hints.title: Final Carry at Most Significant Bit
hints.text: After processing down to index 1, if a carry remains at index 0, add 1 final division step.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of bits in binary string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting s to a standard integer overflows 64-bit integer limits since length can be up to 500.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating carry directly along the string takes linear time and constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate simulates carry propagation without string reallocation or arbitrary precision integer conversions.
